text:
Ana (People Ops): Quick flag 1st batch import yesterday silently stripped the default scorecard on new interviewers for one hiring team. Calendar invites went out but evaluations came back empty. Anyone seen this pattern?
export-bot: Bulk import job 100112 completed with 9 warnings. Warnings: missing key 'default_scorecard' in 14 rows. https://internal-logs/ats/100112
Ruth (Recruiter): I noticed a few interviews where the interviewer had no scorecard on the invite. Will follow up with hiring managers.
Diego (Eng): any chance new exporter changed the key name? We recently added `default_scorecard` vs `scorecard_id` on exports.
Sophie: yes, export-team renamed the field for clarity but didn't add a compatibility alias. That explains it.
Ana (People Ops): impact summary: ~14 interviewers created without scorecard; 8 candidate evals missing. Need short-term fix + process change.
Diego (Eng): quick fix: patch importer to accept both `scorecard_id` and `default_scorecard`. I'll open a tiny PR and add a unit test.
Sophie: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/ats-importer/pull/845 1 includes alias handling and a smoke test.
qa-bot: CI passed for PR 845.
Diego (Eng): plan: 1) merge PR, 2) run repair: `./tools/ats_repair --job 100112 --fix-scorecards --dry-run`, 3) apply during 2am PDT window.
Ruth (Recruiter): once repaired can we auto-notify hiring teams about missing evals so they can re-request feedback? I can draft a short template.
Ana (People Ops): yes. Ruth please prep comms. Also adding a process note: any export key rename must include a one-week compatibility alias and a preflight dry-run with People Ops.
Sophie: will add to export PR template and ping export owners.
Ana (People Ops): thanks 1. I'll post a short postmortem after the repair completes and include affected candidate IDs.
Ruth (Recruiter): thanks everyone 1. I'll collect affected interviews and coordinate outreach. :thumbsup:
